<!-- Starter home page. Expand this into the full GitHub Pages site later. -->

High Low is a two-player card game built from a deck of cards numbered 1 to 9. The dealer flips a card, and the player guesses whether the next card will be higher or lower. The same game supports a probability lesson for grades 6 to 8 and programming lessons in Scratch, Python, and R.

## Probability lesson

- [Probability Teacher Edition](probability-teacher-edition.qmd), with downloads in Word and PDF
- [Player cards (Word)](https://github.com/chelsyschnabel/HighLow/raw/main/Card-Files/cards%201%20through%209.docx)
- [Demonstration cards (Word)](https://github.com/chelsyschnabel/HighLow/raw/main/Card-Files/1%20through%209%20big%20demo%20cards.docx)

- [R version](https://github.com/chelsyschnabel/HighLow/tree/main/R-version) (lesson files in its folder)
